**On-call handoff — gateway 503s**

**Root cause:** Deploy `dep-4471` (gateway, a.novak, 2026-03-14T02:12–02:14Z) shipped config generation 119, flipping `gateway.pool.perRequest` from `false` to `true`. That change exhausted the connection pool (size 20) almost immediately.

**Impact window:** Started 2026-03-14T02:14:18.972Z, first 503 twenty seconds after the deploy finished. Still active at the end of the log, 2026-03-14T03:59:27.974Z, with the wait queue climbing from 13 to 74 over that time. Every error is the same: `ERR_POOL_EXHAUSTED acquiring connection from pool (size 20, in_use 20, waiting N)`.

**Scope:** Gateway only. Checked `worker.log` for the same window — clean, aside from one unrelated pre-existing slow-query warning (`OPS-2210`).

**Action:** Roll back `dep-4471` on gateway, reverting `gateway.pool.perRequest` to `false`.
